description: Read an App Store analytics report as rows, in one step. Give the app (name, bundle ID or Apple ID) and the report name or category; it walks the request → report → instance → segment chain, downloads the gzipped TSV Apple stores behind a signed link, and returns decoded rows. Use this instead of chaining analytics_report_requests / analytics_reports / analytics_report_instances / analytics_report_segments, which ends holding a URL rather than data. Does not start a new report request.

app.description: App name, bundle ID (com.example.app) or numeric Apple ID.

category.description: Narrow the report search to one category.

granularity.description: Which cadence of instance to read. Defaults to DAILY.

max_rows.description: Cap on returned data rows (default 200, hard cap 1000).

processing_date.description: Instance date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the most recent instance Apple has processed, which is usually not today.

report.description: Report name, exact or partial, e.g. "App Store Installations". Omit to list what this app has available instead of downloading one.

name: analytics__get_report

available.description: Present when no report was named: what this app can report on.

segments.description: How many segments were stitched together.

truncated.description: True when max_rows cut the rows short.
